Add a server
Server list › Add server

Install the RemoteMC plugin on your Minecraft server and type /remotemc pair in the game or the server console. Then tap “Add server” in the app and scan the QR code – or type the address and the 6-digit code. The map from /remotemc pair disappears once a phone has paired with it or when you throw it away.
connect, pair, QR, code, new, plugin, install, link
Try the demo server
Server list (empty) › Try the demo server
No server yet? The demo server runs inside the app with sample data. Everything works there – kicking, commands, world settings – and nothing is sent anywhere. Remove it like any other server.
test, example, sample, try out, demo
Sort, pin and group servers
Server list › ⋮ next to a server

The ⋮ menu pins a server to the top, moves it into a folder, renames it, turns its notifications on or off, pairs it again or removes it. Hold a server and drag it to change the order. With several servers a search field appears at the top. Drop a server onto another one to put both into a new folder – the app asks for its name (Cancel puts the server back). Folders can be pinned to the top too (⋮ next to the folder).
order, folder, rename, delete, remove, pin, search, sort
Moderators and viewers
On your server › /remotemc pair moderator
Give friends limited access: “/remotemc pair moderator” lets them kick, ban and chat but not use the console, “/remotemc pair viewer” only lets them watch. The role is shown next to the server name.
role, rights, permission, admin, friend, access, team, viewer
Server overview
Open a server › Overview

Shows how many players are online, TPS (20 means no lag), MSPT, memory and uptime. Green is fine, yellow and red warn about lag. Scroll down for the history, worlds, scheduled tasks, plugins and files.
dashboard, performance, TPS, lag, RAM, memory, uptime, status
Connection and offline
Open a server › status below the name

“Live” means everything is up to date. Tap the status to reconnect. Without a connection RemoteMC shows the last known data and how old it is. If the server stays unreachable, check that it runs and that the port is open.
offline, not reachable, connect, live, refresh, error, firewall, port
Performance history
Overview › History
Charts of TPS, players, memory and MSPT for the last hour, day or week. Choose the time range at the top and the value below it. Gaps mean the server was off.
chart, graph, statistics, trend, week, day
Customize the overview
Overview › hold a card
Hold any card on the overview to edit the layout. Then drag cards to move them, change their width or hide them. “Reset” brings back the original layout.
layout, arrange, hide, move, edit, cards, order
Time, weather and game rules
Overview › Worlds › tap a world
Tap a world to set the time of day, the weather and the difficulty, or to switch game rules like keepInventory. Admins only.
world, day, night, rain, thunder, difficulty, gamerule, keepInventory, nether, end
Manage players
Open a server › Players › tap a player
Tap a player to see health, position, playtime and your own notes about them, and to send a message, heal, change the game mode, teleport, kick or ban.
kick, ban, message, heal, gamemode, teleport, notes, playtime, op
Several players at once
Players › hold a player
Hold a player to select them, then tap others to add them. The bar at the bottom messages, heals, changes the game mode, whitelists, kicks or bans all of them together.
select, multiple, all, several, batch, group
Look at the inventory
Players › tap a player › Inventory
Shows the inventory, armour and ender chest of an online player. Tap an item for its name, enchantments and durability. Nothing can be changed here.
items, ender chest, armor, armour, enchantment
Whitelist and bans
Players › Whitelist / Banned
Turn the whitelist on or off, add or remove names, and see who is banned and why. “Unban” lifts a ban. After removing someone, “Undo” in the message at the bottom reverses it.
unban, pardon, allow, block, list, undo, ban
Console and commands
Open a server › Console
Shows the live server log. Type a command below – suggestions appear while you type, even without a connection. The clock on the left brings back your last commands.
command, log, terminal, suggestions, autocomplete, history, run
Command menu, favorites and macros
Console › book next to Send

The book lists all server commands the app has no button for, sorted by plugin. Save commands as favorites (with {player} or {text} to fill in) and combine several into a macro with pauses, e.g. to announce a restart.
book, favourite, favorite, macro, shortcut, plugin commands, automate
Search the console
Console › Search
Find text in the log, jump between the matches and show only warnings or errors. The share button sends the shown lines, e.g. when you ask someone for help.
find, filter, error, warning, share, copy
Chat with players
Open a server › Chat
Read the in-game chat live, see who joins and leaves and send a message to everyone on the server.
message, broadcast, say, talk, write
Scheduled tasks
Overview › Scheduled tasks
Let the server run commands by itself – every few minutes or daily at a set time, e.g. a nightly restart with a warning to the players beforehand.
schedule, timer, automatic, restart, backup, daily, repeat
Plugins
Overview › Plugins
See every installed plugin with its version and whether it runs. Admins can upload a new plugin (.jar) or remove one; changes apply after a restart.
plugin, install, jar, version, add, remove
Server files
Overview › Files
Browse the server folder, edit configs like server.properties, read logs, upload or delete files. Deleted files stay in a trash for 24 hours – “Undo” brings them back.
file, config, properties, yml, log, upload, edit, folder, trash
Notifications
Settings › Notifications

Get notified when a server goes offline or lags, a certain player joins or someone mentions you in the chat. Quiet hours keep the phone silent at night. Turn them off for single servers in the ⋮ menu of the server list.
alert, push, offline, mention, quiet hours, sound, notify
Widget and quick settings
Home screen › hold › Widgets › RemoteMC

The widget shows the status of your servers on the home screen; a larger widget also shows your favorite commands as buttons. In the quick settings you can add a tile that turns notifications on and off.
home screen, tile, shortcut, launcher, widget
Design, colours and language
Settings › Appearance
Choose light or dark mode, a colour or the colours of your wallpaper, turn animations and vibration on or off and pick the language of the app.
theme, dark mode, colour, color, language, animation, vibration, haptics
Update the app
Pop-up at the bottom · Settings › Updates

When a new version is out, a message pops up at the bottom: “Update now” downloads it, checks it and opens Android’s installer – your servers and settings stay. In the settings you can look for updates yourself or turn the automatic check off.
update, new version, download, install, upgrade
What’s new
Settings › About › What’s new
A list of everything RemoteMC can do, for the phone app, the server plugin and the Windows app.
